nodes.label: DEC-004: Continuous push and cross-IDE agent files
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-004 Continuous push and cross-IDE agent files.md
nodes.rationale: Two requirements surfaced once a second collaborator (Claudio's partner) entered the picture: (1) GitHub must always reflect current work, not just work committed at session end, so a partner can pull main at any moment and see the latest; (2) the project must be fully usable from any AI coding tool on any machine, not only inside the Cursor workspace. Keeping push cadence at session-end only, and using separate tool-specific instruction files with duplicated content, were both rejected as alternatives.

nodes.label: Continuous push policy (commit and push after every meaningful unit of work)
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-004 Continuous push and cross-IDE agent files.md
nodes.rationale: Amends DEC-001's session-end-only cadence. Continuous push has an overhead cost (more, smaller commits) but directly serves the goal that a human collaborator must never be blocked waiting for a session to 'finish'; more frequent commits in history are intentional, not noise.

nodes.label: .gitattributes line-ending normalization (eol=lf)
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-004 Continuous push and cross-IDE agent files.md
nodes.rationale: Normalizes line endings so the repo is byte-identical on Windows, macOS, and Linux, avoiding spurious diffs between collaborators on different operating systems; applied as a one-time repo-wide renormalization pass, already completed.
